budget_notes: Sequential requests only. Reserve US$6.60 before each request; reconcile returned usage at published rates. Missing usage or unknown transport outcomes block all further calls, with the reservation retained. Estimated costs are not audited billing records. No automatic retries, model changes, budget increases or fallback providers.
condition_notes: API is a new experimental condition, not a consumer ChatGPT Search session. Exact original single user prompt, no system/developer additions, conversation ID, previous response or history. Eight built-in calls and 32768 generated tokens are fixed cost controls; reaching either limit is flagged. No paid connectivity probe; the first formal response is the capture preflight.
